notes.title: [Patch Note] 1.2.1
notes.notes:
Hello! ːoguHeartː

We've fixed bugs and typos reported through Discord and the Steam Community.

Map  
  
 Adjusted the placement of temporary obstacles in the Under Cavern.  
  

Bugs  
  
 Fixed an issue where objects that should be destroyed with a charged headbutt wouldn’t function correctly when the device's frame rate drops.  
  

UI  
  
 Fixed text box overflow issues in certain languages.  
  

Localization  
  
 Corrected typos in some English text.  
 Fixed translation errors in some French text.  
  

Thank you!

notes.title: [Update] v1.2 - Action Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=xAxe3zIY4SE;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello everyone! ːogupartyː

We've implemented an action update that enhances speed and improves the synergy between skills, reflecting the feedback you've shared through reviews and on Discord.

Check out the details below!


Controls

Dash  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/adbc07916ce091c7a93d00e56ceb54430ad6a4c1.gif  
After swinging the ladle, press the roll button while moving in the direction you're facing to dash forward.

Backstep  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/df5382fd7fdec4ea80422828ce848a1b2d5c6c9f.gif  
After swinging the ladle, press the roll button without holding the movement key to quickly backstep and evade.

Roll -> Ladle Swing  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/d57e0ca31ecd6b1b7041a272cae8ec2dd1132459.gif  
You can chain a ladle swing while rolling.

Rolling System Update  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/398bc528acea929b8b863f92ea5844c5bdab6280.gif  
The cooldown for rolling has been removed. Additionally, after swinging the ladle, you can now roll in a direction other than where you're facing.

Headbutt Shield  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/c97511436ab81d4fb8e21f60368f637ccf4e883e.gif  
You gain invincibility for the first 1 second while charging a headbutt.

Headbutt Backstep  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/5d2bbcfc1fc9075d0f10ded0c1ad3d3739c23d96.gif  
While charging a headbutt, press the roll button to backstep.

Critical Hit System Update  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/39f28f3f56b025d7340ef787af449183a85f6af8.gif  
You can trigger critical hits more frequently by performing various actions.

Dancing in Excitement  
The time it takes to start dancing when in an excited state has been reduced.

Invincibility Time After Being Hit  
The invincibility time after being hit has been increased from 0.5 seconds to 1 second. Additionally, enemies no longer gain invincibility after being hit.

Trading Cards & Point Shop  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/f02791f5726430b8ba771dda82d66fc78d363f34.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/2c1db2533816218d2f0642c42c0774361526b573.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/e555f70a0cb0ed40123d0dcf1a91583c8596de17.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/f56e332b099767ce6e92616ef434cea91336290b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/42489f9e776a99f92214234296d00068ef978b63.png

Steam trading cards and point shop items have been added. Customize your profile with Ogu and the Secret Forest-themed items!

The Ogu and the Secret Forest Points Shop can be accessed by clicking on the 'Points Shop' tab in the Library, on the Steam launcher.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/6bafb9ea7736223d64fb77280f5a3922e51a63ea.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/a9e597a33e4bd1cefe92bbe08eacf9fb80fdae0a.png


System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/fafa4a0e0351f29a8cb9a211672be831280b3e3e.gif  

 Fixed an issue where Baby Ogu would get stuck on the edge of obstacles.
 Adjusted the colliders of some boss monsters.


Graphics

  
 Improved the swinging motion of Baby Ogu's ladle.  
 Enhanced hit effects.  
 Improved the effects when enemies take damage.  


Content

  
 Some totems’ abilities have been adjusted due to control changes.  
 After clearing Esmeralda's museum quest, the location of the antique shop is now marked on the map.  


System
You can now toggle the controller quick menu on/off in the options.

Bugs
Fixed an issue where enemies hit by Baby Ogu's swing would be pulled towards Baby Ogu while facing backward.




We hope this update enhances your experience in *Ogu and the Secret Forest* with more thrilling and enjoyable gameplay.

Thank you! ːogudanceː

notes.title: [Update] v1.1 - Random Encounters & QOL
notes.notes:
Hello! ːsteamhappyː

We’re excited to introduce the update notes for version 1.1, which includes various new content and quality-of-life improvements.

[previewyoutube=VAuComRGSso;full][/previewyoutube]


Cutscenes Added

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/feb63fc987a5b2ba4748a6ff7a7e146267a911f3.gif

A total of 9 area entrances and key in-game moment cutscenes have been added.
We plan to add a feature that will allow players to rewatch the in-game cutscenes in the future.


Divine Beast Rooms

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/07a2337be1d6e9ead35104ec9c327707bfc562e4.gif

We've added 'Divine Beast Rooms', random encounters that help players collect jewelss, top-tier fish, regional insects, and various cores. You can find 'Divine Beast Rooms' across the world, and by offering items at the shrines, different interactions become available based on the item type.



 Offer common minerals or jewels to access a room with every type of gem.
 You can acquire 1 jewel but if you spend 1 jewel to the shrine, you can acquire 2 jewels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/07643e8853b1582d8eada52900ba46d7252cb79e.png



 Offer bait or fish to access a room where all top-tier fish appear.
 You can catch 1 fish, or 2 fish if you spend a top-tier fish to the shrine.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/4d43c377060cb675599dc072a7e08196c0b91ac7.png



 Access a room where all types of regional insects appear.
 You can catch 1 insect, or 2 insects if you offer a region-exclusive insect.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/156f9dc6216e7f23365f323ce7a1ff6a91f4ddbe.png

Other Encounters

 Offering cooking ingredients(except fishes), upgrade materials, or cores will summon a monster that drops Filthy or Fallen Cores with a 100% success rate.
 Normally, 1 monster will be summoned, but offering a Filthy or Fallen Core will summon 2 monsters. 

In the Divine Beast Rooms, you'll encounter rare collectibles in one place, but obtaining the desired item will require some skill.

Additionally, the more you explore, the higher the chance of encountering a Divine Beast Room.


Newspapers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/ad42d5bacc00ad08bd25e179bf997bac7a5e355b.png

You can now buy newspapers from the consumable merchants in each village.
Using a newspaper provides information about items exclusive to that region.

* If you already know all the information, nothing will happen!


Shell Game

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/122d0b5a976ab0e070b7fcd6fa22c1d4cf59417a.gif

A new mini-game called 'Shell Game' has been added as a random encounter, where you can obtain dish for your adventure journal. By paying a small fee, you can collect dish and fill up your journal.

If you’ve already completed the food section of the journal, you will receive a All-in-One Cooking Kit as a reward.



Cooking Restoration Device

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/2a07e7b28f9630b3d1fa284dc66f40c9a4138489.gif

A random encounter has been added that allows you to turn failed items('Food' or 'Food Waste') into random dishes. This encounter can be used 3 times when found.



Improved Menu Accessibility (Controller)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/5a3aad61cb82765cec6e29578794aa08f476257d.gif

We’ve added interactions to allow controller users to more easily navigate through menus and the adventure journal


Puzzle Hint Addition & Accessibility Improvements

Hints have been added to certain puzzles, and for those that require observation of small objects, we've added areas that zoom in on the screen to improve visibility.


Even after this update, additional updates are planned to make the gameplay experience more convenient and enriching. Please look forward to it!

notes.title: [Patch Note] 1.0 ~ 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello!

We are pleased to introduce the patch notes from the v1.0 update on July 29 to today's v1.0.3 update.

Controls
1. 360-Degree Rotation

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/bd2e6bdb16cd1d31ef5a0985068356df83f49e2f.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/8bf6c5bbbaa144ca920400860ec5cd5d21342a7c.gif

Support for 360-degree movement settings in joystick environments.

2. UI Category Navigation

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/f72e05533b05d230afff96705bfc3106b16d509c.gif

In joystick environments, you can navigate directly to intermediate categories using the special interaction keys. The default settings are LT / RT.

Bugs

 Fixed an issue where DLC hats could not be obtained even after purchasing the DLC.
 Fixed an issue where turrets would not spawn properly in the desert area.
 Fixed an issue where the telescope did not function correctly.
 Fixed an issue where the mayor in the snowy region would freeze after taking damage.
 Fixed an issue where some puzzles in the Moon Forest would cause a game over simultaneously upon completion.
 Fixed an issue where entries in the Adventure Journal would sometimes display incorrectly.
 Fixed an issue where continuing from game over was not possible if joystick key settings were configured in certain ways.


Enhancements

 Improved the visibility of the dowsing hat effects.


UI

 Fixed an issue where progress was not displayed correctly in the save slots.
 Updated the map image of the snowy village.


Maps

 Fixed an issue where the southern cliff of the Miner’s Hot Springs was passable.


Localization

 Fixed an issue where some Japanese characters were not displayed correctly.
 Corrected translation errors in certain Japanese hint texts.


Thank you for your support and encouraging messages for our official release.
We will continue to strive for a better gaming experience.

Thank you!

notes.title: v1.0 Release Streaming
notes.notes: To celebrate the v1.0 release, a video of Gimgi, the composer responsible for the sound and OST of 'Ogu and the Secret Forest,' playing the recent version will be streamed for two weeks.

notes.title: [Dev Log] Summer Sale & Official Release
notes.notes:
Hello! ːsteamhappyː

We are working hard for the official release on July 29th.

Currently, "Ogu and the Secret Forest" is on a 15% discount during the Steam Summer Sale, which will be the last discount before the official release. If you haven't purchased "Ogu and the Secret Forest" yet, consider doing so now!

The major issues we're working on are the final battle and ending, which are still under wraps, and improving the convenience of existing content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/80456a45fdbaf4e8416306d91439d05f6d6bb843.png

To avoid spoilers about the final battle, here are some improvements you'll see in the official release:


1. Display of Fish Species at Fishing Spots

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/eeef5da0a7ff8792a360b6ef81bc1afe28e89b16.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/2ebf570b6402a031f35af7d383a95a1b70c021ec.gif

New signs will be placed at each fishing spot, showing the types of fish that appear there. Fish you have caught before will be highlighted.


2. Cooking System Changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/d0b114bd4b90fb8e6a07e825e408641a99b8a09b.gif

The cooking system has been improved as follows:

When There is No Recipe
Selecting ingredients not in a recipe will now not proceed with cooking and will display a message indicating that there is no related recipe.

Cooking Gauge and Extra Rewards
A gauge showing the progress of the cooking process has been added.

 If the gauge is very low at the end of cooking, food waste is created.
 If the gauge is low, food is created.
 If the gauge is normal or above, a dish is created.
 If the gauge is very high, 2 dishes are created.



3. Sold Out

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/cb8c8bc58f563a2ae7a27bb13ddd77b99593e1cd.gif

When all items are purchased from shops that sell limited items like equipment and interior goods, the shop shutters will close.


4. Sun Village Telescope

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/37c137350a126b8a00f042688f6cd39fd1afda13.gif

Looking through the telescope at the Sun Village observatory, you can now see the scenery that was previously displayed as text.


5. Baby Ogu Dance

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/baf435d760d57cb8dbd25f5e18700b1a2a95799b.gif

If you don't control Baby Ogu for a certain period, he will dance in place.



We will continue to provide updates on development and release news until the official launch.

Please look forward to the official release on July 29th!

notes.title: 0.6.2 Patch Note & Dev Log

Hi!

Added a drawing journal

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/3b40d2ee3c65ec665d5a4824d9bc38687814ab9e.png

Texts

Bugs

Thank you!

notes.title: Full Release Date Trailer & Upcoming Price Increase
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=dGHIbPeRFbQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Ogu and the Secret Forest is officially releasing on July 29 after a year and four months of Early Access.

We'd like to thank the Steam community and Discord for all the feedback and bug reports during Early Access. We'll do our best to wrap up development until the full release so that you can end your journey with a great finale.


Price increase coming soon

After the full release, we will be increasing the price slightly, as stated in the 'Early Access' description.
The price increase will be 24.99 USD, up about 7 USD from 17.99 USD.
(Actual game prices may vary slightly from country to country based on Steam's regional pricing policies.)


Full release promotional content

Starting with the release date announcement trailer above, we will be producing a variety of promotional content leading up to the release date.

Those who have already played the Early Access version will have the opportunity to look back on their journey, For those who haven't yet played 'Ogu and the Secret Forest', this will be a chance to introduce the game's large area and diverse content.

We look forward to seeing you there!

Thank you!

notes.title: [Patch Note] Update History
notes.notes:
Hello, for your pleasant gameplay experience, we quickly fixed and patched the bugs reported through Discord after the Thursday 0.5 version update. Below are the modifications made so far.

Maps and Content

 Fixed an issue where entering the Trial of the Waterfall boss map again would start a battle without the boss.
 Fixed a bug where doors wouldn't open when re-entering the Thunder Island boss map.
 Corrected an issue where hats could not be obtained even after clearing the puzzle on Penguin Island.
 Fixed occasional freezing during tennis matches.
 Resolved bugs related to new hats with skills applied, such as the Volcano Hat and Cowboy Hat.
 Adjusted the field image and obtained image of the new totem to match.
 Corrected inappropriate reset locations for new puzzles.
 Fixed the issue of inappropriate items appearing at the fishing spot at the entrance of Dusky Town.
 Addressed the exploit allowing quick acquisition of quest items in Dusky Forest using the SoongSoong Balloon.
 Corrected instances where players could access physically unreachable areas in some maps.
 Updated map images to accurately reflect actual terrain.


System

 Fixed an issue where Baby Ogu's second swing would sometimes miss.


Corrected occasional errors occurring while drawing the picture diary.
 Addressed the issue of outer jungle enemies obstructing each other's movement.


Text

 Added missing dialogue for "Dolph".
 Updated "Alma's" phone dialogue to align with the update.


Sound

 Added missing sounds for new hat skills.
 Fixed the issue of overly loud sounds when completing puzzles in the Temple of Cooking.


We apologize to those who were inconvenienced by the bugs and truly appreciate all the feedback and reports you have sent us.
We will continue to work hard on development until the official release.

Thank you!

An area with a short sub-quest line. You can enjoy a mini-game of tennis.

Sea

- Lantern Fish Cave

A cave with a new sub-boss.

Snowfield

- Penguin Island

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/3c9db9165fae8bff7a970fa0d00e5100e7a9ddc1.png

Central Forest

- Tucker's Lab
A map with quests and a new sub-boss.



Convenience

Save Data Notation Modification
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/11175c4cd4828f193e34c9541ff532cc6c385f9e.png

Changed to a notation that shows progress, current health, and gold possession.

Collectible System Improvement

System

- The variety of items sold by village merchants has been expanded.

- If you recover health beyond the maximum with food, you gain a cheerful state for 3 seconds per amount recovered.




We will work hard to develop more fun and polished content for the official release.

Thank you!

notes.title: [Patch Note] Snowfield Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!ːsteamhappyː
Here's a summary of the updates from the 0.4 version released this Monday to the 0.4d version updated today!


Maps and Content

 Fixed an issue where ice obstacles in the Crystal Mine would reappear after leaving and re-entering the map.
 Modified the battle with Koofu to allow knockbacks with swinging and headbutt attacks.
 Fixed an issue where the hot spring visit quest in the Snowfield area was not being counted.
 Added areas where headbutt tooltips appear.
 Fixed an issue where players could climb onto the wind-blowing device.
 Added information about the use key to the headbutt tooltip.
 Adjusted the position and shadows of some pillars in the Sky Island to fix awkward placements.


Bugs

 Fixed an error that occurred when rapidly pressing buttons while drawing in the Picture Diary.
 Fixed the issue where interaction outlines appeared during inoperable cutscenes.
 Corrected the issue where the fire made by the Bonfire Hat was interactable while disappearing.
 Fixed layering issues with some monsters in the mission to rescue trapped monkeys.
 Corrected a problem where achievements were not being unlocked after meeting Rahno.
 Fixed a bug in the Adventure Journal progress tab where the Sky Island item couldn’t be clicked with a mouse.
 Resolved errors that occurred when pressing esc during item acquisition, quest addition, and similar situations.


Sound

 Fixed the missing sound of the bear guard during the Snowfield Village cutscene.
 Added sound effects for the 4th stage of the headbutt.


Steam Deck

 Fixed an issue causing infinite loading on certain map transitions.

Thank you all for your feedback and reports sent through Discord.

notes.title: 'Ocean' update is coming soon!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/9a843495187ba4a543b985762baa610ccd142f69.png

Hello! ːsteamhappyː
We know you've been waiting, and we're excited to announce that the next area, 'Ocean', will be in mid-October.

Most of the new area contents are developed and currently undergoing internal tests and adjustments.
Here are some of the contents that will be added in this Ocean update:


New Area: Ocean

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/96759a5726d72e7cf623262b3851327a46e3d35d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/bdb4831ae9a6d570dc463f061c662853fad1af07.png

The Ocean is located to the southwest of the world and can be accessed through the Apple Forest, northwest of the Frog Prairie.
Baby Ogu needs to assist the Water Deity, Enki, to resolve the strange occurrences in the Ocean.

Additionally, you'll get a more direct glimpse of the evil deity that's putting the world at risk.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/93df5fe6ec770db6d60b5ebc97d650f0dfd0f931.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/69b34ced547c646cf5fdf91229315ebb4f3fc30e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/f276038aac0338fde3a88dedac0452efa9a223f9.png

The Ocean area consists of various themed maps, from blue seas and sandy beaches to the expansive underwater realm with buried temples.
Additionally, with the new 'Swimming' feature, you'll be able to traverse water areas in places you've already visited.


Threats Looming Over the Ocean

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/39a27940bfa050d1dee24dcd5758cbf9db594e82.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/d2520c96b8441a909a0285399bde658db3c87b1b.gif

The power of the evil god is reaching into the ocean, where the ritual to separate the gods has taken place.
Eliminate the holes created throughout the ocean and fend off enemies imbued with the evil god's power.


Swimming

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/88c2e96616d988b78a55f4db3b04eb87971c1bc8.gif

Now, you can traverse through most of the aquatic areas.
Including the oceanic region where you learn to swim, you will now be able to access previously unreachable water zones.
(Additional content related to swimming areas will continue to be added up until the official launch.)


Totems
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/d7044f9a37c9734a7f086f28ab0c6eeba543cdf9.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/9018d01166ed687b6bd473fdb5cc6010d4761e9e.png

You can now use totems, relics imbued with the divine power of the deities.
Priests, starting with Kokou, unlock these totem slots, and you can ultimately open up to 4 totem slots.

When you equip a totem, its effects, such as increased critical hit rate or enhanced healing, are automatically activated under various conditions.

Given the divine power within the totems, they are planned to be rewards found deep within each temple or in challenging dungeons.

We'll introduce more about the upcoming ocean area update through Steam announcements step by step until its release.

notes.title: [Update] Restaurant & Totem
notes.notes:
Hello! ːsteamhappyː

We've been quite busy over the past couple of months for preparing two game shows. Furthermore, we're in the thick of developing for our next game update. The upcoming Water Sector update is set to launch in mid-October, after we attend the Tokyo Game Show and undergo about two weeks of testing.

Also, just today, we rolled out a small update introducing the 'Restaurant' management and parts of the totem system.

Please check out the details below!


Restaurant

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/5475b0e683bb0b2a8db8c0ab5c620705c3763042.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/43b701a065fc65aba82f4fd368d8383fb77b4394.png

You can run the restaurant for a day by selecting four dishes for which you know the recipes. Serving more expensive dishes can earn you more money, but they also take longer to prepare. Customers will get impatient and leave the restaurant if made to wait for too long, so it's crucial to balance your menu appropriately.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/67c97348cc8990714505842daef6ad87672f8f6c.png

Additionally, each restaurant has its regular customers.
If you serve dishes that contain ingredients these customers favor, you can receive tips!


 Olive Restaurant: Salt, Century Plant, Grade 1 & 2 Fish, Piranha
 Gordon Restaurant: Grade 1 & 2 Herbs, Grade 1 & 2 Roots, Light Reed Leaf


In the restaurant, we sell items that can skip the cooking process, and they are also awarded as bonuses at the end of the operation. These will be particularly helpful when making a large number of dishes or when cooking with expensive ingredients.

To operate a restaurant, you'll need a recommendation from the chefs of each restaurant, Olive and Gordon.
* If you've previously met Olive and Gordon and completed their quests, you will automatically receive their recommendation upon starting the game. Please take note!


Totem
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/d7044f9a37c9734a7f086f28ab0c6eeba543cdf9.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/3f16906228d39f6bc3907496712d0ea11859d533.png

You can now use the totems imbued with the power of the deities!
Equip totems in the four available slots to gain passive effects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/9018d01166ed687b6bd473fdb5cc6010d4761e9e.png

By equipping totems, you can gain additional effects when eating fruits, reduce the cooldown of rolling, and benefit from various other situational bonuses. Totems are intended to be rewards for meeting deities or clearing challenging dungeons.

The totem system will be fully integrated after the Water Region update scheduled for mid-October.
With today's update, we've introduced the totem system, allowing players to explore up to two available slots.



Drawing

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/7febd6ca6947f2f9b1e136331dc7724f5c57b0e1.gif

The process of Baby Ogu drawing a picture diary has been added. By pressing a button, you can see the drawing being completed step by step.


Unlock Maps

A new animation has been added when a region is unlocked by drawing a picture diary.


Update Notice

We've added a notification system to ensure that if previously played content is updated, players won't miss out on the updated content or need to start over from the beginning.


Bug Fixes & Changes

 Fixed an issue where maps were not properly displayed in some countries.
 The save slot system has been revised. Instead of accessing all save slots while playing, it has been changed to save in each slot individually.
 Fixed an issue where players could access the main menu during the Mecha Rat battle.
 Resolved an issue where some users were unable to exit the navigation mission after the previous update.



Thanks!

notes.title: Demo Update & Development Progress
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! ːsteamhappyː
Hope you’ve all spent a wonderful new year.

We’ve been hard at work for the early access release this March.
After this version update on the demo, we’ll soon begin the 3rd closed beta test. (Korea Exclusive)

These are the updates for the demo version and the current development.



1. Demo Version Updates

Monkey Sentinel
A lot of people suggested that the amount of puzzles in the beginning area was overwhelming. So we’ve decided to include a new combat for the ‘Monkey warehouse’ and ‘The Temple of the Sun’ by including a new adversary.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/43bccd08fdc24973a4e420310e604a0029411474.gif

The monkey sentinel will be using the rock fist ability similar to the sun golem’s attack.
During movement it will not take any damage however when it’s stationary, it will. The monkey sentinel will be stationary for it to engage the attack. So that’s when you may strike it.


Additional Garbage Monsters
The Temple of the Sun has more enemies for combat now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/b6e985a1f31c12dcc0ca420a9eb157f63ff47c37.png



2. Current Development Situation

4 Major Regions for the Early Access
The early access that will begin this March has 4 major regions of the Secret Forest. These include Jungle, Moon Forest, Desert and part of the main field region.
Currently we’re fine tuning the details for these areas. Other than a few side quests and visual details, the development is complete on all 4 of the major regions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/b6e2855d2c928ef82bd4ae7dc2b448ac91311f46.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/ef2d5aa9c7375448fdd911312ac8c9661947ff9b.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/8fdfcaeace5553aa20dd918974037eade28862a2.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/16e7ba838681e30d67bac5bb73805777ecf657df.png



Housing System
The ‘Hero’s House’ located in the ‘Village of the Sun’ now is being renovated for it to be able to be customized.

You may place various housing collectables that are found throughout the adventure. There will be a variety of objects like cooking bonfires, hot springs, pots where you can grow plants and so on. These will let you customize your house to your liking and help your adventure even further.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/35dbf8eae9cb8d4b0653d0f73a667395036fedc4.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/37c514166c84ec594f5e0ecb46d720716decf5f7.gif



These are the current updates. We are near the first milestone and are very focused for a better player experience. Thank you in advance for being patient with us. Hope you all have a wonderful day!

notes.title: Demo Version Update
notes.notes:
Hello! ːsteamhappyː

The early closed beta after the update on June, we've made a lot of improvements. 
Due to these reasons we needed to make several changed to the Demo Version of the game as well.

These are the changes that we made.

Collectables

1. Bug Catching

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/d4f5369cd32e67d7bfe9232807613516b359636a.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/546fa09d7c4706cad233905e8e25ad637aae3fda.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/5f0468aad7661d1dfdf37b1912c09c2644742b1f.gif

The 'Bug Catching' system has been included.
Main three types of bugs will be flight, tree and grass. There will be around 30 types of bugs to catch.
These can be sold to the market or exhivited on the 'Museum' which will be updated later.

2. Monster item drop

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/12bff952b84d477aae87514e53af6a312b639ded.gif

There will be item drops from the adversaries in the game.
The dropped items can be sold to the market, utilized to upgrade the gear or may be used in various quests.

3. Timing of Fishing Changes

The fishing timing has been improved so the swinging and the catching timing is more reasonable.

Maps

1. Random Encounters

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/dda3e49d7ae6bd88619c382ffed916b4177c8607.gif

Random encounter system has been added.
During the Baby Ogu's adventure through various areas of the world, there will be random encounters.
It could either be shops or garbage monsters so that the adventure of Baby Ogu can be more exiting.

2. Area Graphical changes

Many area's artwork images, layers and physics has been improved.

Puzzles

Pushing Animation Update

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/4d7ccc4a95c071be40610b108148de4e3d1e4f9b.gif

Most requested improvement during our closed beta was about the pushing system.
The pushing action now has been updated so that the interaction with the object is improved.

'The Temple of the Sun' Changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/a5adc2b6452e92e1564df95020b1b7527cdd9803.gif

One of the rooms in ‘The Temple of the Sun’ has changed from puzzle to a combat scenario.



System

'Dancing' Changes

Baby Ogu's 'Dancing' ability has been changed to only replenish half of the health bar.
However, there will be a new status effect called 'Exited'.
The 'Exited' status will let Baby Ogu to heal to full health bar as usual.
This status will be acquirable through visiting a town or consuming certain food.

UI Changes

1. Quest UI Changes
Various changes to the UI has been made regarding quests.
Now the undiscovered quests will be noticed. Recently acquired quests and completed quests will be separated.

2. Main Title Theme Music and Image
Title screen's main theme music and image has been updated.

3. Basic Control Changes
Keyboard, Controller, Mobile controls has been changed accordingly.

4. Camera Work Changes While Running Animation
When Baby Ogu is running, the camera will now pan to a wider view.

5. Visual Special Effects
The visual special effects has been added when Baby Ogu's health is low or if there are negative status effects. 

These are the few updates that has been added due to the small portion of the demo version.
We have already developed so much more and we're eager to show you all of it very soon!
We will continue to develop restlessly until early access next year. So that we can give you the best, dynamic and exiting gameplay experience as we can.

Thank you so much!
